name: mtg-deck-pricer
description: Paste a Magic: The Gathering decklist to get exact per-card prices (USD, EUR, MTGO tix) at the cheapest printing, the deck total, legality and deck-rule checks for every format, the mana curve and colors, and budget swaps under a price.

interface.longDescription: Paste any Magic: The Gathering decklist (MTG Arena, MTGO, Moxfield or Archidekt export, or a plain list) and see what it costs: the price of every card at its cheapest printing and at the printing in your list, in US dollars, euros and MTGO tix, with the deck and sideboard totals. The same check catches what AI-built lists get wrong: cards that do not exist (with the closest real names), banned and not-legal cards, a Commander deck that is not exactly 100 cards, extra copies, cards outside the commander's color identity, and the number of Commander Game Changers for brackets. You also get the mana curve, color pips against mana sources, card types and deck roles such as ramp, card draw and removal. Budget mode finds the cheapest printing of each expensive card and cheaper cards that do the same job, in your colors and format, under the price you choose, while keeping the cards you name as the core of the deck. Card data, images and prices come from Scryfall and are refreshed daily; prices are market estimates, not store offers. No account needed. Unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Wizards of the Coast Fan Content Policy; not approved or endorsed by Wizards.
defaultPrompt: How much is my Commander deck?
Is this EDH deck legal and which bracket?

positive.description: Price and check an official Commander precon
positive.prompt:
How much does this Commander deck cost and is it legal?
Commander
1 Killian, Decisive Mentor

Deck
1 Scriv, the Obligator
1 Sol Ring
1 Arcane Signet
1 Land Tax
1 Animate Dead
1 Ghostly Prison
1 Anguished Unmaking
1 Command Tower
8 Plains
8 Swamp
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Killian, Decisive Mentor as the commander (color identity WB), gives the price of each card at its cheapest printing and the total in USD, EUR and MTGO tix, flags that the deck has 25 cards instead of exactly 100, reports no banned cards and no Game Changers, and shows the mana curve and color pips. Says the prices are Scryfall's daily estimates.

positive.description: AI-generated list with a banned card, a misspelling and an invented card
positive.prompt: ChatGPT built me this Atraxa deck, is it legal in Commander? Commander: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice. 1 Mana Crypt, 1 Sol Rng, 1 Doubling Season, 1 Infinite Proliferation Engine, 1 Cyclonic Rift, 95 Island
positive.expected_behavior: Flags Mana Crypt as banned in Commander, says 'Sol Rng' is not a real card and suggests Sol Ring, says 'Infinite Proliferation Engine' is not a real Magic card, and reports the deck total and the Game Changer count (Cyclonic Rift).

positive.description: Standard legality and price of a tournament list
positive.prompt:
Is this deck Standard legal and what does it cost on Cardmarket?
4 Opt
4 Steam Vents
4 Spirebluff Canal
4 Riverpyre Verge
6 Island
4 Sleight of Hand
4 Eddymurk Crab
4 Prismari Charm
3 Burst Lightning
4 Traumatic Critique
4 Hearth Elemental
4 Sunderflock
2 Spell Pierce
2 Winternight Stories
2 Get Out
2 Impractical Joke

positive.expected_behavior: Checks the 60-card list against Standard, reports it legal (or names any card that is not), gives the euro total and the most expensive cards in euros, and shows a mana curve with 16 one-drops.

positive.description: Budget version under a per-card cap, keeping core cards
positive.prompt: Make my Atraxa deck cheaper: every card under $2, but keep Doubling Season. Commander: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice. Deck: Cyclonic Rift, Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Demonic Tutor, Doubling Season, Swords to Plowshares, Sol Ring, Command Tower, 92 Plains
positive.expected_behavior: Never suggests replacing Atraxa or Doubling Season. For Cyclonic Rift, Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe and Demonic Tutor it lists cheaper cards with the same role (removal/board wipe, card draw, ramp, tutor) inside white-blue-black-green and legal in Commander, each under $2, and points out the cheaper printing of Swords to Plowshares; it shows the deck total before and after.

positive.prompt: I want this Pioneer deck under €25 total, cards under €1.50 each. 4 Llanowar Elves, 4 Elvish Mystic, 4 Steel Leaf Champion, 4 Old-Growth Troll, 4 Nissa, Who Shakes the World, 4 Questing Beast, 36 Forest
positive.expected_behavior: Uses euros and Pioneer legality. Lists the cards above €1.50 (such as Questing Beast and Nissa, Who Shakes the World) with cheaper Pioneer-legal green cards and their prices, gives the deck total now and with the swaps, and says whether €25 is reached.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It is free, with no paid features.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: price a pasted MTG decklist card by card (USD, EUR, MTGO tix) at the cheapest printing and as listed; legality and deck rules for every format (deck size, copies, color identity, Game Changers); mana curve, color pips and roles; budget swaps under a per-card cap or deck total.
